title: Gemma 3 text (1B): dense, 5 local : 1 global attention, sandwich norms, centered RMSNorm, no softcap; runs the Gemma 4 flow's dense arm
open_questions: no lab measurement yet: the first install was a correctness gate (Q4_K_M against Q8_0 decode), not a benchmark
chunked prefill and the GQA-shared decode kernel were never measured on this family; it keeps the Gemma 4 flow's defaults
traps: the norms are CENTERED (1 + w) here and plain on Gemma 4: the install stores the unbaked value and the flow picks the centered kernels by family
no V norm and no layer scalar, unlike Gemma 4: both are family-keyed switches in families/gemma4/
